description: Get detailed information about a specific type: its components, properties, methods, interfaces, and optional members. Use this to understand a type's structure before creating instances or subtypes. `specRef`, on the type and on a member, is the link to the section of the specification that defines it: cite it.

alias.description: Companion spec alias where the type is defined (e.g. "machinery")

name: get_type_details
title: Get type details
